# Tranception — upstream-derived working copy `UPSTREAM_DERIVED` · `BASE RESEARCH AUTHORSHIP NOT CLAIMED`
This repository is retained as a working/reference copy of the upstream **Tranception** research codebase. **Official upstream:** https://github.com/OATML-Markslab/Tranception **Paper:** *Tranception: Protein Fitness Prediction with Autoregressive Transformers and Inference-time Retrieval* (Notin et al., ICML 2022) The Tranception research, paper, base implementation and primary authorship belong to the Marks Lab / OATML authors and upstream contributors.
